readback.name: Poincare.DeTurckConstructedCovariance.chartLift_differential_covariance
readback.mathematical_statement: Fix E = ClosedSmoothModel 3 = EuclideanSpace real (Fin 3), I = closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3, Bilin = E ->L[real] (E ->L[real] real), Jet1 = E ->L[real] Bilin, Jet2 = E ->L[real] Jet1, and Variables = (Bilin times Jet1) times Jet2. The displayed letI dictionaries give Jet1, Jet2, the background connection carriers E ->L E ->L E and E ->L E ->L E ->L E, and the product carriers their canonical continuous-linear-map operator norms, real normed-space structures, maximum product norms, and componentwise addition. The norm of E is the standard Euclidean norm; these dictionaries introduce no replacement or rescaling. Universally quantify a universe u and type M : Type u with TopologicalSpace, T2Space, ChartedSpace E M, and a smooth IsManifold I infinity M structure; genuine smooth Riemannian metrics g0,bg on M; a point liftAnchor : M; and F : E -> Bilin. The metric carrier contains symmetric positive definite inner forms, von Neumann bounded metric unit balls in the given tangent topology, and smoothness of the metric section. No compactness, connectedness, completeness, or identity g0=bg is assumed. Assume F is C-infinity on all E, HasCompactSupport F, its topological support tsupport F is contained in the actual target of c_l = extChartAt I liftAnchor, and for all z,v,w : E, F(z)(v,w)=F(z)(w,v). The support is the closure of the nonzero set and is compact; the manifold itself need not be compact. Define H = DeTurckChartLift.chartLift liftAnchor F. This is a concrete dependent tangent-bilinear section: at x in c_l.source, H(x)(u,v)=F(c_l(x))(A_x(u),A_x(v)), with A_x=mfderiv I the real E model c_l x; at every x outside c_l.source, H(x)=0. No free section, supplied lift identity, or regularity certificate substitutes for this definition. For each anchor a and coordinate y, let C_a(q)=CovariantDerivative.chartMetric q a be the unblended inverse-chart pullback of a tangent-bilinear section q. Let G_a=C_a(g0.inner), J_a=D G_a, K_a=D(D G_a), F_a=C_a(H), JF_a=D F_a, KF_a=D(D F_a), B_a=GeodesicTransport.chartChristoffelField bg a, and DB_a=D B_a, where D is ordinary real Frechet differentiation in E. B_a is the Christoffel field of the blended chart representation of the fixed background metric bg. Define DQ(a,y)=DeTurckJetLinearization.differential (B_a(y)) (DB_a(y)) (G_a(y)) (J_a(y)) (K_a(y)) ((F_a(y),JF_a(y)),KF_a(y)). This is the entire defined finite-jet differential. Writing e_i=basis3(i) and A_ij=inverseEntries(G_a(y))_ij, its principal terms are the sum over i,j of A_ij times KF_a(y)(e_i)(e_j), and the sum over i,j of deltaA_ij times K_a(y)(e_i)(e_j), where deltaA_ij=-sum over k,l of A_ik times F_a(y)(e_k)(e_l) times A_lj. It also includes the actual Frechet differential of (G,J) -> DeTurckPrincipalIdentity.lowerTerm (B_a(y)) (DB_a(y)) G J at (G_a(y),J_a(y)), applied to (F_a(y),JF_a(y)). Both inverse factors, the variation against the initial second spatial jet, and the complete lower differential remain present; the background B_a and DB_a are held fixed. Now universally quantify anchor1,anchor2 : M and z : E. Assume z belongs to c1.target, where c1=extChartAt I anchor1, and x=c1.symm(z) belongs to c2.source, where c2=extChartAt I anchor2. Define phi=c2 composed with c1.symm and z2=phi(z); the named chartTransition is exactly phi, and chartTransitionDeriv at z is D phi(z). Assume GeodesicTransport.cutoff anchor1 equals 1 eventually in nhds z, and GeodesicTransport.cutoff anchor2 equals 1 eventually in nhds z2. These assumptions require both fixed smooth blending cutoffs to be identically one on the respective coordinate germs; mere membership in the chart targets is not the cutoff premise. The conclusion is pullbackBilinearForm (DQ(anchor2,z2)) (D phi(z)) = DQ(anchor1,z). Equivalently, for every u,v : E, DQ(anchor2,z2)(D phi(z)(u),D phi(z)(v))=DQ(anchor1,z)(u,v), as equality of whole continuous bilinear forms. No nonlinear covariance, derivative certificate, metric variation family, time derivative, flow equation, arbitrary supplied transition map, invertibility package, or desired conclusion is a premise. The sole perturbation is the explicitly constructed chart lift of the smooth compact symmetric F. The statement proves this full linearized differential's pointwise coordinate covariance on the two cutoff-one germs. It does not yet assert covariance for arbitrary C2 or Holder/Graph perturbation germs, give a global operator or norm estimate, cover overlap points outside those one-regions, or construct a Ricci/DeTurck flow. No circular or fake input appears in the literal assertion.
